threads.body: @copilot Please remove this opt-in and instead remove the `thread.id` and `thread.name` assertions from `processAttributes()`, along with unused imports. The default changed intentionally, and these assertions only check that the ID is nonzero and the name is nonblank; they do not verify Kafka Connect behavior. `ThreadDetailsCustomizerProviderTest` already covers thread details being absent by default and present when enabled. Keep the container on the new default and update the PR title and description to match.

replies.body: Removed the container opt-in and the `thread.id` / `thread.name` assertions, including unused imports. `:instrumentation:kafka:kafka-connect-2.6:testing:compileTestJava` passes.
